topic: Bison Energy acquisition and merchant-terminal status
wiki_text: Tabeer Energy is developing a merchant FSRU terminal at Port Qasim, Karachi, with a peak send-out around 750 mmcfd. The project was originally a Mitsubishi/Diamond Gas International venture; in September 2023 the Competition Commission of Pakistan approved the UAE-based Bison Energy FZCO's acquisition of 100% of Tabeer Energy Pvt Ltd (TEPL) and Tabeer Energy Marketing Pvt Ltd (TEMPL) from Diamond Gas International Japan Co Ltd. OGRA granted Tabeer a RLNG marketing licence (Jan 2021) and a construction licence (Apr 2021). As of 2025-2026 the project remained pre-FID, with a Phase-2 FID (gasification facility plus a long-distance pipeline) repeatedly delayed by unresolved pipeline-capacity availability.
